messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval ALERT: 4 suites flagged vs baseline (run id 2026-03-19-03). summary: instruct-stable -8.9% accuracy, fewshot-instruct -6.2%, longcontext-coherence -4.7%, smallbatch-int4 -5.1%.
eval-bot: affected model: rdx-2.1-int4 (new quant bring-up). severity: medium. auto-created thread for triage.
maya: seeing the same in the dashboard. instruct-stable cohort 'financial-qa' has worst delta.
cheng: can you paste an example of the bad generation from that cohort?
maya: sure — sample from nightly run (prompt id fqa-042):
```
PROMPT: "What's the current interest rate for the national savings bond?"
BASELINE: "As of 2026-03, the national savings bond rate is 1.25% (source: gov)."
OUTPUT (rdx-2.1-int4): "Savings bonds pay 4.5% annually, guaranteed."
```
liam: yikes, that's a clear factual regression (hallucination). likely quantization amplification on numerical facts.
chenG: @maya @liam assigning owners: maya -> instruct-stable cohort lead, cheng -> quantization lead, nisha -> eval infra.
maya: ack. immediate plan: 1) rerun failing suites on rdx-2.1-fp16 to confirm baseline, 2) run int8 and int4 deterministic seed, 3) snapshot KV-cache stats.
ops-bot: deploy note: dedicated runners for rerun scheduled on gpu-pool-b at 03:45Z.
cheng: ordering of runs: fp16 -> int8 -> int4, batch size 1 to isolate batching noise. also we should disable adaptive prefix caching for the rerun.
liam: logging checklist: attach prompt ids, full model logits for the first 64 tokens, and generation sampling params. add label 'regression-suspect' to failing examples.
nisha: I'll add the eval job with deterministic seeds and increased logging, will ping when results ready. ETA ~25m.
maya: initial severity set to P2 (user-facing but limited cohort). if fp16 passes and int4 fails, we'll mark as quant-specific and rollback int4 candidate.
cheng: if int4 shows systemic drift, we should fallback route to fp16 variant in serving policies. will draft rollback play.
liam: also please run a quick embedding similarity check vs baseline for that cohort — to see if prompt encoding changed.
maya: noted. I'll start collating failing prompts and create a short repro notebook for PMs.
ops-bot: rerun job started (job id rerun-347890-A).
eval-bot: update: rerun fp16 completed, instruct-stable cohort shows nominal delta (+0.2%). int4 rerun in progress.
(12:25) cheng: int4 rerun finished: confirms -8.6% instruct-stable. attaching gist link in thread: https://gist.github.com/rdx/regression-snip-347890
maya: thanks. next steps: rollback int4 candidate, tag model as 'rdx-2.1-int4-paused', open PR to revert int4 promoted version in model catalog.
liam: add regression alert to the release board and notify product owners of affected cohorts. small write-up: probable quant-induced numerical degradation impacting factual prompts.
maya: will file a short postmortem if rollback goes to prod. for now, owners: cheng (quant lead), maya (cohort lead), nisha (eval infra).
cheng: assigning follow-ups: quant debug (chad) for kernel selection, tracer (me) for per-layer activation diffs.
maya: thanks all. will update once rollback is in effect. :thumbsup:
